ambient: The dry buzzing continues through the interval, in case you thought it was over.
Nothing resumes. Nothing has ended either.
The pause holds, exactly as long as it's going to hold.
description: The playback has stopped for a moment, and there's nowhere to go and nothing to do with the moment. Everything you have just been shown is still in the room, at rest, waiting to resume. Nobody is asking you for a verdict. There's going to be more.
name: The Interval

looks: It hasn't been put away. It's paused, and it keeps.
You can look at any of it for as long as you like, which is the difficulty.
None of it has moved since it stopped.
objects.name: what's still in the room

looks: Not restful. A gap in something that's going to continue.
You could use it for something. There's nothing here to use it for.
It has a length, and you can feel the whole length of it.
objects.name: the moment

weather: The night outside hasn't moved on at all, and it won't until this does.
